result:
I'd make curiosity the default human setting instead of tribalism and self-deception.

Not "make everyone smarter" or "end suffering" or any of the usual grand gestures. Just rewire the species so that the first instinct when encountering something confusing, uncomfortable, or convenient isn't to protect your ego, your tribe, or your story—it's to figure out what's actually true. Everything else (technology, cooperation, long-term planning, reduced bullshit) cascades from that.
